'''Hobo burgers''' are a camping classic. Wrapping the meal in cabbage leaves helps to preserve moisture and prevent burning.   

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (about 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Ground beef|ground beef]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], thinly sliced 
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]] 
*8 [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]] leaves 
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
#Mix Worcestershire sauce into beef. 
#Cut four large sheets of heavy duty [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminium foil]] and place a cabbage leaf onto the shiny side of each one. 
#Shape beef into 4 patties and place onto cabbage leaves. 
#Top each portion with onion and potato slices, add a pat of butter, and season with salt and pepper.
#Wrap another cabbage leaf around the top of each portion and seal each package. 
#Place on medium-hot coals for about 20–30 minutes, turning twice (carefully) while cooking.
#Discard cabbage leaves if they become charred during cooking.
